title: 1.8 gigapixel ARGUS-IS. World's highest resolution video surveillance platform by DARPA
summary: A short clip about DARPA's ARGUS-IS, a 1.8 gigapixel wide-area camera array flown on a Boeing unmanned helicopter. It produces a huge mosaic video that can watch a city-sized area from 20,000 feet.
why: Cited in surveillance threads as a concrete example of persistent wide-area aerial surveillance that already existed in 2013.

quote.text: This is a documentary clip from 2013 that shows what the cameras and systems in these blimps can do.
